mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix definition allows the model to invent permissions not in the spec (e.g., Patient -> PostNotes), which violates least-privilege. LeastPrivilege assertion checks that any permitted operation respects the matrix.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.user.role = Patient and ae.operation = PostNotes and ae.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the structural constraint on notes allows the model to construct notes with empty or malformed state, which the assertion catches by requiring at least one well-formed note to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MalformedNote { some n: ClinicalNote | n.body = "" }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the structural constraint on audit entries allows entries with missing fields, which the assertion catches by requiring well-formed entries.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MalformedAudit { some ae: AuditEntry | no ae.user }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the uniqueness constraint allows duplicate audit entries for the same (user, record, operation) triple, which the assertion explicitly forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAudit { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.user = ae2.user and ae1.record = ae2.record and ae1.operation = ae2.operation }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the authentication boundary check allows audit entries with no associated user, which violates the assertion that every operation is by an authenticated user.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAuth { some ae: AuditEntry | all u: User | ae.user != u }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the care-team gate allows clinicians to read/append without membership, violating the ownership-based access rule that clinician operations require active care-team membership.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamBypass { some ae: AuditEntry, u: Clinician | ae.user = u and ae.operation in (GetRecords + PostNotes) and ae.outcome = Permitted and no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = u and m.record = ae.record }
